headline: Chanakya Reddy Baddam Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Promoter-linked shareholding disclosure filed under SEBI Regulation 31(4) by Chanakya Reddy Baddam for Apollo Micro Systems, signalling either a concert-party consolidation or a substantial acquisition event triggering takeover code disclosure.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure of acquisition of shares where either a single acquirer reaches 5% or more, or where persons acting in concert reach that threshold collectively. Apollo Micro Systems, a listed aerospace and defence electronics company, saw this filing on 19 June 2026. The disclosure does not, from the headline alone, signal a hostile bid; it may represent internal regrouping among promoter families or strategic concert-party formation. The full details of acquisition structure, timeline, and consideration remain in the detailed filing.
